mission.goal: Deliver a separate, proof-gated BCO-Prime v3.1 release with trust-pinned signed baselines, deterministic drift, privacy-first incremental capability extraction, sticky regression quarantine and shadow-only repair planning while preserving sealed predecessors.
mission.user: Kim Kagiso Mosiane as owner and local operator
mission.workflow: Verify a signed baseline against an external trust fingerprint, compare complete local state, scan authorized local sources, classify drift and holds, generate a non-executable repair plan, append one scoreboard event and return a hash-bound receipt.
mission.data: Contained local files, complete predecessor archive manifest, policy/capability/test/result baselines, semantic Capability DNA, occurrence identities, scanner holds, drift events, scoreboards and proof receipts.
mission.stack: Python 3.12 standard library plus the unchanged inherited v2/v3 modules and verified adjacent CFF dependency
mission.environment: Isolated local filesystem with one on-demand process, no network crawler, provider adapter, daemon or deployment
mission.governance: Formation A1 local authority, documentation gate, JARVIS target mode, zero-harm preflight, RealityGuard, ProofOS, external trust-root requirement, sticky quarantine and no stable promotion.
mission.failure: Typed rejection, hold, quarantine or cancellation for invalid scalar types, effect escape, signature/trust/replay failure, incomplete coverage, path/symlink/root/file races, budgets, secrets, licences, dependency gaps, test/result drift, concurrency and rollback mismatch.
mission.testing: Syntax, 67 repository tests, standalone exhaustive route proof, signature/tamper/replay, privacy/licence, path/race/concurrency, cancellation, sticky quarantine, strict coercion, fresh extraction, package integrity, MODISA and RealityGuard.
mission.deployment: NOT_APPLICABLE: deployment, registration, provider mutation, recurring execution and stable promotion are not authorized.
mission.continuity: Signed baseline, append-only scoreboard, source/archive manifests, package and receipt hashes, README, architecture, Formation specification, project memory, AI handoff and ChatBridge.

assumptions.stack: Python 3.12 standard library; Linux flock is available for local writer serialization.
assumptions.runtime: The caller invokes one bounded process and supplies exact roots, mission version and external signer fingerprint.
assumptions.storage: Baseline, scoreboard, pointer and proof stay below caller-selected local roots.
assumptions.authentication: Source authority is explicitly scoped; baseline trust is an externally supplied public-key fingerprint. No provider credentials are used.
assumptions.deployment: The artifact is packaged for private retrieval only. Provider activation requires a separate authority cycle and semantic readback.

components.frontend: NOT_APPLICABLE: the supported surface is a CLI and Python library.
components.backend: SuccessorRegistryV31 strictly dispatches nine additive operations and delegates every inherited namespace.
components.database: Append-only hash-chained local scoreboard JSONL plus atomic baseline and control-pointer JSON.
components.queue: NOT_APPLICABLE: dispatch is synchronous and bounded.
components.worker: The invoking Python process runs one locked cycle; no worker survives return.
components.scheduler: NOT_APPLICABLE: no schedule or background daemon is created.
components.cache: NOT_APPLICABLE: every integrity check rehashes in-scope files; cursor state only resumes extraction.
components.storage: Contained local roots with safe relative paths, no-follow reads, size/count/depth limits and atomic replacement.
components.authentication: External trust-root fingerprint, baseline generation and parent hash authenticate comparison state; source ID, tenant and matter bind scans.

architecture.state_model: REQUESTED -> TRUST_VERIFIED -> COMPARED -> SCANNED -> SCORED -> COMMITTED, or SIGNATURE_HOLD, PARTIAL, SECRET_HOLD, LICENSE_HOLD, HOLD, QUARANTINED, CANCELLED, CONFLICT or ROLLED_BACK_CONTROL_POINTER_ONLY.
architecture.transaction_boundary: One nonblocking interprocess cycle lock; cancellation checks before lock, compare, candidate and commit; one O_APPEND+fsync scoreboard event is the commit.

failure_controls.INVALID_INPUT: Strict Boolean/integer/finite JSON checks, normalized effect-key denial, schema/range/path validation and deterministic ordering.
failure_controls.AUTHORIZATION_FAILURE: Missing external signer fingerprint, bad generation/parent, source bindings, secret/licence hold and external effects fail closed.
failure_controls.TIMEOUT: Budgets, cancellation checkpoints, no unbounded retry and on-demand stop prevent runaway work.
failure_controls.PARTIAL_WRITE: Atomic baseline/pointer replacement, locked scoreboard append, fsync and complete chain verification reject truncation.
failure_controls.MISSING_CONFIGURATION: Missing trust, signing seed, cursor key for partial resume or bounded root returns an exact hold or BLOCKED_WITH_ROUTE.
failure_controls.EXTERNAL_API_FAILURE: NOT_APPLICABLE: no external API exists; network/provider requests are rejected before dispatch.

observability.correlation_ids: Mission, mission version, cycle ID, baseline body hash, scanner scope hash and scoreboard event hash.
observability.health_checks: Canonical core=100, v3=14, v3.1=9, runtime on demand and all effect/promotion flags false.
observability.structured_logs: Hash-bound operation receipts and canonical JSON scoreboard events.
observability.audit_logs: Signed baseline envelope, complete predecessor manifest, drift receipt, scan diff, shadow plan and append-only scoreboard.
observability.metrics_alerts: Coverage, scanned files/bytes, holds, drift classes, hard veto count, score and quarantine state; no remote sink.

testing.unit: Lamport signing/verification, secure hashing, secret/licence detection, semantic DNA, cursor HMAC, drift classes, score and repair plan.
testing.integration: Registry inheritance, all nine v3.1 routes, governed cycle, scoreboard append, cancellation and control-pointer rollback.
testing.e2e_or_smoke: CLI health and standalone verifier across 100 core, 24 legacy, 2 meta, 8 expected-blocked engine, 14 v3 and 9 v3.1 routes.
testing.fixtures_mocks: Temporary roots, ZIP predecessors, signed baselines, safe/secret/licence sources, tampered cursors/signatures and interprocess lock contention.
testing.failure_first: Signature tamper/substitution/replay, signer absence, ZIP duplicates/traversal, symlinks, partial coverage, secret metadata, licence compounds, hard regressions, sticky quarantine, effect-key variants, string Boolean coercion and verifier seed length.

delivery.file_tree: Inherited upstream and cff_unpacked siblings plus four v3.1 modules, manifest, exhaustive verifier, four v3.1 test files, architecture, policy, baseline, proof and three handoff documents.
setup_commands: Use Python 3.12 or later; no third-party package installation is required.
rollback_commands: Stop v3.1 invocation and select the sealed v3.0 package; the optional rollback operation changes only a verified local control pointer.

debugging.SIGNATURE_OR_BASELINE_HOLD: Verify the external fingerprint, generation, parent, body and envelope hashes; never trust a replacement key from the baseline.
debugging.PARTIAL_OR_UNKNOWN: Complete the bounded scan or resume with a valid signed cursor; do not claim deletion or no-drift.
debugging.SECRET_HOLD: Exclude the held source from DNA; no raw secret/path/symbol data is emitted.
debugging.LICENSE_HOLD: Supply compatible authoritative dependency licence evidence or keep the capability quarantined.
debugging.CONCURRENT_CYCLE_CONFLICT: Preserve the active cycle and retry only after its lock is released; never duplicate a commit.
debugging.QUARANTINED: Repair and independently retest under a new mission; this system cannot auto-clear quarantine.

formation.effectful_permit: Single-use Formation permits gate each isolated local write, test, package and private persistence action.

watchman.blocked_capability: Untrusted baseline signing, partial no-drift, automated repair application, monitored-source mutation, network/provider effect, deployment, registration and stable promotion.
watchman.blocker: The runtime has no external signer authority, provider executor or deployment authority; held or partial evidence cannot be promoted.
watchman.safe_substitute: Trust-pinned verification, local complete comparison, privacy-first extraction, sticky quarantine and declarative shadow repair planning.
watchman.closure_test: Supply an authorized one-time signing seed, persist its public fingerprint in a separate trusted receipt, complete every scan, pass all tests and obtain separate provider authority with semantic readback.

continuity.idempotency: Pure receipts are deterministic; cycle IDs, one lock, baseline generation, hash chains and control-pointer hashes reject duplicate or stale effects.
continuity.checkpoints: Signed baseline, scanner cursor, cycle scoreboard, source/archive/package manifests, Formation packet, release receipt and ChatBridge.
continuity.resume_conditions: Verify sealed lineage, package/source manifests, external signer fingerprint, scoreboard chain and current mission version, then rerun the suite.
continuity.stop_switch: Terminate the invoking process. No worker, scheduler, queue, lease, network session or recurring task remains active.

test_results: 67 of 67 repository tests passed, including all 53 predecessor tests.
The standalone verifier passed 100 core, 24 legacy, 2 v2 meta, 8 expected-blocked engine, 14 v3 and 9 v3.1 routes.

Concurrent flight appends, effect-key variants, strict scalar types, trust-root substitution, signature tamper/replay, privacy/licence holds, partial scans, cancellation, sticky quarantine and rollback mismatch are permanent regressions.
The first verifier signing fixture was correctly rejected for a 31-byte seed; the repaired fixture uses the exact required 32 bytes.
proof.deployment_readback: NOT_APPLICABLE: no deployment or provider mutation is authorized.
semantic_verification: Health preserves canonical core=100, v3=14 and adds exactly 9 v3.1 operations.
A clean trust-pinned complete baseline produces NO_DRIFT and PASS; partial, tampered and hard-regression cases veto.
Secret-bearing files emit no DNA/content/raw metadata, and all repair candidates remain declarative executable=false.
Cycle cancellation prevents commit; rollback changes only the local control pointer.
